customManagers.description: Track Node for the 24 line. This repo ships ONE Node major -- the line derived from the root UPSTREAM_VERSION (see build/version.sh) -- and the cap below keeps it on 24.x: Node 26 arrives as a new repo, not by moving this manager or raising the cap.

packageRules.description: The 24 line stays on 24.x. Not an automerge exception -- automerge is the family default (ship-if-green) and still applies; this only stops Renovate from walking the line onto a Node major it was never built for.
